landing.metaTitle: Finance — see where the money actually goes
landing.metaDescription: Upload your household's card statements and let AI sort every transaction into Fixed, Necessary, and Nice to have — then track your real net profit, statement cycle after statement cycle.

hero.title: See where the money actually goes.
hero.body: Upload your card statements and let AI sort every transaction — by type (Fixed, Necessary, Nice to have) and by category (Groceries, Transport, and more) — then watch your household's real net profit, statement cycle after statement cycle.
hero.noCard: Free for your first 50 classified transactions. No card required.

steps.title: From raw statement to real number in minutes.

upload.title: Upload your statement
upload.body: Export your card statement as CSV and drop it in. Map the columns once and every future upload just works.

sort.title: Let AI sort it
sort.body: Claude reads every transaction and buckets it — Fixed, Necessary, or Nice to have — and tags a category like Groceries or Transport, with a confidence score.

track.title: Track your net
track.body: Watch combined net profit across the whole household, statement cycle by statement cycle.

features.title: Everything a household needs to stay honest with itself.

groups.understand: See where the money actually goes
groups.control: Plan ahead and stay in control
groups.household: Built for your household, owned by you

ai.title: AI classification
ai.body: Every transaction typed and categorized automatically, with the reasoning and confidence behind each call.

insights.title: Spending insights
insights.body: Twelve-month trends, top merchants, biggest movers, your Fixed / Necessary / Nice-to-have mix, and your top spending categories.

recurring.title: Recurring & subscriptions
recurring.body: We spot every recurring charge and total the monthly spend you've quietly committed to.

transfers.title: Transfers, not spending
transfers.body: Money moved between your own accounts is detected and kept out of your spending totals.

budgets.title: Category budgets
budgets.body: Set a monthly budget per category and watch each envelope fill as the cycle goes on.

forecast.title: Net worth & runway
forecast.body: Track net worth, see how many months of runway you have, and project the next year of cash flow.

savings.title: Savings on autopilot
savings.body: Set a goal and a date — we infer whether you're on track from your spending, with no bookkeeping.

balance.title: Balance checks
balance.body: We flag any account whose imported transactions don't add up to the balance you recorded.

import.title: Import any statement
import.body: Drop in a CSV from any bank — columns are detected automatically and re-uploads never duplicate a row.

banksync.title: Automatic bank sync
banksync.body: Connect your bank and let transactions flow in daily, no file needed. Available on Premium.

household.title: Shared by household
household.body: One financial picture for a couple or family. Everyone uploads, everyone sees the whole.

export.title: Your data, always yours
export.body: Export everything to JSON whenever you like, and use the app in Icelandic or English, light or dark.

categories.title: Automatic categories
categories.body: Every transaction is also sorted into a category — Groceries, Transport, Eating out, and more — so you see spending by category, not just by type. Filter by it, hide what you don't use, or add your own.

pricing.title: Start free. Upgrade when it earns its keep.
pricing.subtitle: The Free plan classifies your first 50 transactions for good. Premium keeps every statement cycle sorted.
